environmentQuirk.observed: The verification shell exported PORT=0, so a plain 'npm start' bound a random ephemeral port instead of 8787 while still logging startup.ready.
environmentQuirk.resolution: Start with 'env -u PORT npm start' or set PORT explicitly in .env; documented in the README troubleshooting table. Ordinary shells are unaffected.
